mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 750K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 750K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY, indicating a strong supply side, supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns when INDPRO YoY growth > 2% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3% QoQ, signaling robust demand, predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ growth > 3%, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Whenever the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is hiked by more than 50bps in a single meeting, the surprise tightening predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances following a FEDFUNDS hike > 50bps, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 6%, coupled with a rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 300K, forecasts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to the combined labor market surprise.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE drop below 6% and PAYEMS rise above 300K
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) growth above 5% YoY, indicating strong consumer spending, supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Oct-Dec).
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2.5-year rolling window (holiday season only), or 60-day forward returns during the holiday season when RSAFS YoY growth > 5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
